To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we find the medium effect on $PS$ interaction is much more significant than that of the $PV$ interaction.
the $CSB\;PS$ interaction is more sensitive to medium modification of the $\pi$ and the $\eta$ propagator than that of $PV$ interaction.
the $CSB\, III$ potential is dominated by the in-medium $\eta$ meson propagator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of in-medium $\eta$ propagator and nucleon mass on the $CSB$.
the effect of the in-medium $\eta$ meson propagator on the charge symmetry breaking interaction in the nuclear medium.
the effect of in-medium $\eta$ propagator on $NN$ $CSB$ interaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the $CSB$, which is caused by $\pi-\eta$ mixing, is significantly modified in NM, especially for the PS interaction, compared to the free space.
the medium effect on $\pi$-$N$ coupling constant is not so important to $CSB$, but that of $\eta$-$N$ one is very important to $CSBs$.
the in-medium $\eta$ meson propagator plays a crucial role to the $CSB$.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the $CSB$, which is caused by $\pi-\eta$ mixing in NM, can be significantly modified by in-medium $\pi-\eta $ propagators and off-shell $\pi-\eta-$ mixing amplitude, which is related to the nucleon self-energy in NM.

, the $CSB\,III$ potential is strongly dependent on the medium modification to $\pi$ and/or $\eta$ propagator and the $CSB \,III$ potential becomes more repulsive for the PS interaction compared to the PV interaction.

the $CSB$, which is originated from $\pi$-$N$ coupling, is enhanced in nuclear matter and the enhancement of $CSB$ in nuclear medium is found to be more significant than the enhancement of $NN$ interaction in nuclear medium.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the medium modification to $\pi$ and/or $\eta$ propagator can be used as an effective way to understand the $NN$ $CSB$ interaction in the medium.
the in-medium meson mass modification plays a significant role in $CSB$ interaction in the nuclear medium.
, $CSB$ effect in the $NN$ interaction is significantly modified in nuclear medium.
